critique: The black background, fiery yellow/orange/red palette, and clearly downward motion from t1 to t4 now read as falling sparks. Density is improved, but the effect remains a narrow, centered vertical plume with very small dot-like particles. It lacks the broader, more substantial shower and longer descending field expected of the Falling Sparks thumbnail; the bright source cluster is also too compact relative to the frame.

suggestions.why: Longer particle life preserves more sparks through their downward travel, creating the extended falling trail/shower rather than a compact cluster.
A wider directional spread opens the tight central column into a more natural, broader spark shower.
Increasing maximum particle size makes the individual embers read as substantial glowing sparks instead of mostly pixel-sized dots.
